verdict.summary: This is a Baby swing with mosquito net (model BB501), an inclined infant sleeper. The verdict is Don't buy because inclined sleep products with an incline over 10 degrees have been banned as hazardous products since November 12, 2022, making their sale unlawful.
verdict.seller_message: Hi, thanks for listing this.
